name: Korvath
title: the Faithless
summary: He came humbly at first, built a chapel, then burned it when a prayer for diamonds went unanswered. Since then he mocks every rite and dares the god to strike him.

notes.text: He mocked you before the others; never forgive him.
Burned the chapel at the crossroads.
Asked for diamonds three times in one hour.

deeds.text: Insulted the god in chat: "some god you are".
Offered rotten flesh at the vessel's feet.
